title: Thumb War Challenge
description: Verse a non player in a thumb war!

title: Yellow Spotto
description: Its spotto time. Take a photo of 5 yellow items of clothing.

title: Motorbike Selfie
description: Take a selfie with a motorcycle or moped.

title: Statue Mimic Selfie
description: Take a selfie with a statue, posing like the statue.

title: 60-Second Laugh Chain
description: You must laugh continuously for 60 seconds out loud. For every non player that starts laughing you receive an extra band.

title: Nutbush Dance-Off
description: You thought you was slick, but can u make the Nutbush drip? Do the nutbush for 1min. You receive 1 bonus band for every non-player that joins.

title: Staring Contest
description: Challenge a non player in a staring competition.

title: Show and Tell
description: Time for show and tell...(it's been a while) Find a non player, and do a show and tell of something in your bag.

title: Signature Handshake
description: Make a handshake up with a team mate. Film it. Each player gets a band.

title: Dap Clap Capture
description: Dap up a non player. See if u can capture the clap!

title: Straw Sprint
description: Collect drinking straws from different locations. You have 3 minutes from now to find the first straw. Every time you find another straw, the timer resets to 3 minutes. The challenge is over when your timer ends. 1 Band per straw. If you find no straws, the challenge is vetoed.

title: Napkin Dash
description: Collect napkin from different locations. You have 2 minutes from now to find the first napkin. Every time you find another napkin, the timer resets to 2 minutes. The challenge is over when your timer ends. 1 Band per napkin. If you find no napkins, the challenge is vetoed.

title: Pet the Dog Request
description: Ask someone: \n Can I pet that dawg? You must film yourself only, not them.

title: Fire Hose Photo
description: Take a photo of the nearest fire hose.

title: Traffic Light Star Jumps
description: Walk to the nearest traffic light. Do star jumps until the light changes.

title: Photo with Security
description: Take a photo with a Police officer / Security Guard / Mall Cop

title: Bird Count Selfie
description: You have 3 minutes, starting now. Take a selfie. For each different bird in the photo, you get a band. You get 1 attempt. If you fail to get a single bird in the photo, the challenge is vetoed.
